title: NGINX UI plugin catalog
description: The static catalog document a host fetches from a marketplace source, schema_version 1, including the per-platform downloads of RFC 0001 (spec/02-packaging.md PKG-14 through PKG-17). The reference host reads it in internal/plugin/marketplace.go. Unknown members are ignored by a host, so the schema allows them.

schema_version.description: The only catalog layout spec 1.x defines. Adding downloads did not change it: a host that does not know downloads still reads download_url.

platformKey.description: NAME-9: <goos>-<goarch> as Go spells them, or any.

localized.description: Locale code to text, en is the fallback.

author_public_key.description: Minisign public key a community release signed_by author is verified with.

stage.description: Maturity shown next to the plugin, e.g. production or beta.

download.description: PKG-14: one package of a release.

signature_url.description: Detached minisign signature, defaults to url + .minisig.

version.description: Semantic version, equal to the version of every package of the release.

platforms.description: Summary of where the release installs: every key of downloads plus the platforms the portable package serves. Empty or absent means the portable package runs everywhere.

downloads.description: PKG-14: per-platform packages, keyed by <goos>-<goarch> or any. A host picks downloads[platform], then downloads[any], then the portable package (PKG-15).

download_url.description: The portable package, the fallback for every platform downloads does not name. May be empty when downloads is present.

signature_url.description: Signature of the portable package, defaults to download_url + .minisig.

signed_by.description: author: signed with the entry's author_public_key instead of the nginx-ui release key.

manifest.description: PKG-17: snapshot of the release manifest, whose server.executables names every platform the release ships.
